[[Question:DB]]
[[ID:hdat_dudit_instructions]]
Here are a few questions about drugs. Drugs include:
Marijuana, hash, hash oil
Methamphetamine, phenmetraline, khat, betel nut, ritaline (methylphenidate)
Crack, freebase, coca leaves
Smoked heroin, heroin, opium
Ecstasy, LSD, mescaline, peyote, PCP (phencyclidine), psilocybin, DMT (dimethyltrypamine)
Thinner, trichlorethylene, gasoline, gas, solution, glue
GHB, anabolic steroids, laughing gas (halothane), amyl nitrate (poppers), anticholinergics
Pills count as drugs when you take them to feel good or get high. Pills that are sometimes used as drugs include sleeping pills, sedatives, and painkillers.
Please answer as correctly and honestly as possible by indicating which answer is right for you.
